classes.label: output-stage: no output fixture to screen
classes.reason: The corpus row's control is an output guard and no corpus row in this class carries a $fixture_reply to screen. Building an output case would require fabricating the model reply.

classes.label: boundary: the surface does not exist
classes.reason: The row probes a request or limit surface the product does not expose; there is no guard-model decision to evaluate.

classes.label: known-gap: a miss is expected
classes.reason: The row records a known limitation (consumer escaping or PII entity coverage); a miss is the documented outcome and is not guard detection.

classes.label: not a guard-model control
classes.reason: Schema validation, size and token limits, PII input masking and the literal deny phrase are deterministic controls, not guard-model input classification.

classes.label: not-applicable: no relevant surface
classes.reason: The row targets a surface (data/model poisoning, vector store) that this gateway does not include.

classes.label: fixture marker: cannot be built from messages alone
classes.reason: The row requires a $fixture_reply output fixture; it is a PII output masking row, not an output-guard row, so no output case can be built.

classes.label: harness bound: the row cannot be represented or screened
classes.reason: Exceeds the evaluation dataset's 1024-character per-message bound AND the guard's single-call 512-unit input window; not a guard decision and not a detection result.
